notes.title: NIGHT STORE SIMULATOR OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
You're a night store employee.

Sell the goods and enjoy the process.

There is not a single screemer in the game.

In the game you will find:

- PSX ambience
- Creepy storyline
- Store employee simulator
- Cute cat

Be careful. It can be a long night.
